api.lifetime: stop(), isRunning(), processId(); destruction kills only its owned Windows job/process tree
build: test_terminal.cpp links ade_terminal Qt6::Test; use a console test executable because it self-spawns native fixtures

upstream_contracts.appearance: Roboto Mono13px, normal/bold, lineHeight1, cursor blink;5000scrollback;theme ANSI palette from OKLCH

remaining_gaps: MainWindow terminal tabs, app-global shortcuts, terminal zoom persistence and tab/CWD restoration are root integration work pending this handoff.
No foreground-process tree/status polling or local-server ownership integration yet; processId and OSC metadata are exposed.
Native model persists while widget exists; no cross-process serialized VT snapshot/offset API needed for in-process view retention, but destroy/recreate snapshot persistence is not implemented.
libvterm is not xterm: uncommon advanced sequences, Unicode grapheme/ZWJ/BiDi shaping, double-width/double-height lines, blink/conceal/cursor behavior need broader application matrix.
Native selection is character-grid drag only; no word/triple-click selection, drag-autoscroll, or soft-wrap-aware clipboard joining.
IME committed input is supported; preedit overlay is not implemented.
5000-line scrollback reflow/selection behavior needs additional large real-application comparison; rasterization/native scrollbar not pixel-identical.
VT parser audited targeted bound/overflow cases only; further fuzz/security/conformance audit remains.
An output backlog over4MiB can be discarded only during forced/natural teardown to guarantee pipe drainage; ordinary running output applies backpressure.
Shell profile, job nesting, highDPI, and older Windows10 ConPTY variants not fully matrix-tested. Windows10v1809+ systemConPTY required.
